BasePilot is now **PixelChief**, and Google Play Games no longer needs the game window in sight.

- **New name.** The app, the exe (`PixelChief.exe`) and its data folder are now PixelChief. On first start PixelChief copies your BasePilot settings, player list and saved window across by itself; the old `BasePilot.exe` can be deleted. The session launcher `tools/avvia_sessione.bat` now starts `PixelChief.exe`.
- **Hide the game window.** *Settings → Hide game window* moves the Clash of Clans window off the screen: the bot keeps playing and the window is out of your way. *Show game window* brings it back, and so does the next start of PixelChief if it closes meanwhile.
- **Minimized game detected.** A minimized Google Play Games window cannot be seen by the bot. Start now stops with a message saying so, and a session stops the same way instead of clicking blind.
- The guide is online: https://leixien.github.io/pixelchief/ (desktop or mobile layout, switch at the top).

Download **PixelChief.exe**. Tesseract is bundled. **PixelChief.exe.sha256** contains its SHA-256 checksum. The exe is unsigned, so SmartScreen warns on first launch.

Hide game window has not been run on Windows before this release. Testers: press *Hide game window*, then *Start*, and report whether the bot keeps attacking. If it sees a black screen, *Show game window* and tell us.
